system_overview.description: SumTotal to CSOD data transformation and validation pipeline
system_overview.architecture: Multi-component system with field-level, file-level, and cross-file validation
system_overview.validation_philosophy: Three-tier validation: Source validation, Transform validation, Cross-file integrity
system_overview.current_state: Field-centric validation with basic cross-file analysis (NOT proper PK/FK relationship tracking)

MANDATORY_EMPTY.description: Mandatory field is empty or null
MANDATORY_EMPTY.remediation: Source: mandatory field empty. Requires data correction.

TRUNCATION.description: Field value exceeds character length limit
TRUNCATION.remediation: Source: field exceeds length limit. Adjust target or truncate data.

ENCODING_ISSUE.remediation: Source: invalid characters. Fix character encoding.

HETEROGENEOUS_TYPE.remediation: Workshop: mixed data types. Standardize approach needed.

DUPLICATE_RECORD.remediation: Transform: duplicate found. Implement deduplication logic.
DUPLICATE_RECORD.detection_method: Hardcoded unique column checks in transform_sumtotal_file()

TYPE_COMPATIBILITY.description: Field value is not type compatible

DATE_FORMAT.remediation: Workshop: invalid date format. Transform to target format.

LEADING_SPACES.remediation: Transform: leading whitespace. Auto-fix with trim.

TRAILING_SPACES.remediation: Transform: trailing whitespace. Auto-fix with trim.

OUTLIER_VALUE.remediation: Source/Workshop: outlier detected. Validate and correct.

LEADING_ZEROS.description: Numeric field has unwanted leading zeros
LEADING_ZEROS.remediation: Workshop: unwanted leading zeros. Confirm removal.

DELIMITER_ISSUE.remediation: Source: delimiter issue. Implement detection logic.

validation_triggers.field_type_specific: Each validation runs based on Neo4j field_type mapping
validation_triggers.mandatory_fields: MANDATORY_EMPTY runs only on fields marked 'Mandatory' in Neo4j
validation_triggers.all_fields: HETEROGENEOUS_TYPE, ENCODING_ISSUE run on all field types

completeness_analysis.methodology: Count non-null values in mandatory fields vs total records

duplicate_detection.limitation: Hardcoded list, not dynamic based on business rules

error_summarization.description: Aggregates validation errors by type per file

current_implementation.description: MANDATORY FIELD VALIDATION ACROSS FILES - NOT PROPER PK/FK TRACKING
current_implementation.method: Field name matching between files using Neo4j field mappings
current_implementation.problem: Does generic pattern matching instead of business relationship validation
current_implementation.example_current_logic: Finds fields with same names (ActivityCode, EmployeeID) across files
current_implementation.what_its_not_doing: NOT checking primary key -> foreign key orphaned record relationships

what_it_should_be.description: PRIMARY KEY / FOREIGN KEY ORPHANED RECORD TRACKING
what_it_should_be.proper_methodology: LEFT JOIN analysis to find orphaned foreign key records

current_discovery_mechanism.method: Neo4j query finding shared field names
current_discovery_mechanism.problem: Finds field name matches, not business relationships
current_discovery_mechanism.false_positives: Matches unrelated fields with same names

error_logs.purpose: Store all validation errors with context
error_logs.record_volume: High - one record per validation error

file_completeness_summary.purpose: Track field completeness metrics per file
file_completeness_summary.record_volume: Low - one record per processed file

cross_file_integrity_summary.needed_usage: Should store PK/FK orphaned record analysis

csv_exports.format: file_name, section, field, severity, anomaly, rate%
csv_exports.llm_integration: Uses LLM to generate business-friendly anomaly descriptions
csv_exports.remediation_mapping: Maps validation types to remediation actions

data_validator.purpose: File structure and mapping rule validation
data_validator.validation_scope: Input files, mapping rules, transformation syntax

neo4j_integration.purpose: Field mapping rules and constraint definitions
neo4j_integration.usage: Drives validation rules and cross-file discovery

mysql_integration.purpose: Error storage, completeness tracking, result persistence
mysql_integration.performance: Optimized with indexes and batch processing

flask_web_integration.purpose: File upload, processing coordination, report generation

cross_file_analysis.issue: Pattern matching instead of business relationship validation
cross_file_analysis.impact: False positive relationships, missed orphaned records

hardcoded_business_rules.issue: Unique field checking and relationships hardcoded in Python

performance_scaling.issue: Linear performance growth with relationship count
performance_scaling.impact: 9.2 seconds for current dataset may not scale

relationship_discovery.issue: Neo4j data model doesn't match actual file structure
relationship_discovery.solution_needed: Update Neo4j or use fallback business rules

Implement LEFT JOIN orphaned record analysis instead of field name matching
architecture_improvements: Move hardcoded business relationships to Neo4j configuration
Implement dynamic business rule discovery from graph database
Add relationship validation with confidence scoring

Add connection pooling for high-volume processing
Optimize SQL queries for large dataset handling
